Absorbed 19-family specialist system (Look 2) reaches 2343.8 Elo [2181.2, 2619.2] (rev20 ladder fit [2195.4, 2612.5]) on Dev91, ahead of Kumo-Tabular-Large (2070.2), TabFM-1.0 Ensemble (1915.6), Kumo-Tabular-Small (1900.2), TabFM-1.0 Single (1888.1), and TabPFN-3.5 (1851.6).

Generalist stack without per-family or per-table dossiers scores 1859.0 Elo in-corpus on Dev91 (+7.4 Elo above TabPFN-3.5 on the 35-entrant Fit A ladder, 4W-0T-15L head-to-head across 19 families), proving the +484.8 Elo separation within Fit A (to 2343.8, absorbed: not a generalization comparison) comes from random-split dossier absorption.
Pre-registered system trained with 0% Dev91 exposure scores 1821.5 Elo [1697, 1990] on its single pre-registered read; a subsequent seven-read adaptive series reaches 1842.0 Elo in its separate fit.

Exact ledger replay across all 61,814 family-specialist training episodes and all 155,937 GEN2A per-table training episodes confirms 0 official-split partition hits on 91 of 91 Dev91 contexts (maximum observed SEARCH row share in any episode: 82.33%).

claims.claim: On the pre-frozen 32-table bank-disjoint validation panel, M-scale (23.7M) cross-entropy loss improves monotonically across fair checkpoints (3.9569 -> 3.9087) and across all-data r3 -> r4 -> r5 checkpoints (3.9605 -> 3.9539 -> 3.9480), while fresh-row cross-fitted specialist probe skill peaks at 500 exposures/row (+1.185 u vs 0.852 u init).

Strict inner-CV kernel admission (requiring >= +0.5 u gain on every inner fold over a fixed nonlinear dictionary + ridge baseline) raises held-out win precision across 3,639 tables from 56.22% (unconditional) to 99.28% (137/138 admitted tables, mean +2.3827 u).

Calibrated neural + boosted-tree classification stack outperforms standalone CatBoost and LightGBM on 676 binary tables (mean ROC-AUC 0.7568 vs 0.7516 and 0.7421) and 199 multiclass tables (81.41% win rate vs CatBoost, 95.48% vs LightGBM on LogLoss).

Public benchmark evaluation on TabArena v0.1 (8 regression + 35 classification tasks) and BeyondArena 2026 (36 regression + 94 classification tasks) is pre-registered per regime (unseen vs in-corpus before absorption, then absorbed after pre-reads lock) anchored at RF (default) = 1000 Elo.
